title: Glacier segmentation public panel display assets

source.description: 147 publicly displayed comparison figures archived from the original Shiny application.

processing.description: Deterministic rectangular crops of rendered RGB scientific figures, encoded as lossless WebP.
processing.cropConvention: [left, top, right, bottom]; right and bottom exclusive; original image pixel coordinates.
processing.compression: lossless WebP; each decoded image is byte-identical to the source RGB crop

limitations: Images are recovered rendered visualizations, rather than original satellite arrays or model output arrays.
Original rendered colors and antialiasing are retained; image colors must not be treated as exact class probabilities.
Accuracy values reproduce the public application display and retain its reported three-decimal precision.
No coordinates, class coverage, IoU, model metrics, or other measurements have been inferred.
